facts.title: Why is Samson's story even in the Bible?

items.msg: first VO line equals the title
'secret' — make sure the text really says this: 'Then came Delilah. She tried to hand him over three times, and he still told her'
'all' — make sure the text really says this: 'Blinded, the man born to fight the Philistines was brought out to entertain them'
'never' — make sure the text really says this: 'He began to save Israel. He couldn't finish. The Philistines never beat Samson. '

answer stated in the Turn/Landing: 'God raised Samson to begin to save Israel, but the Philistines never beat Samson; Samson did. Israel's rescuer needed rescuing himself. Jesus came to save his people from their sins, and on the cross he said, "It is finished."'
